dimensions.assessment: Potentially affects all taxpayers and businesses who electronically submit tax documents or payments to the IRS.
dimensions.evidence: If any return, claim, statement, or other document required to be filed, or any payment required to be made... is sent electronically by any person

dimensions.assessment: Provides administrative certainty regarding submission dates for electronic filings and payments rather than altering tax liabilities.
dimensions.evidence: the date on which such return, claim, statement, or other document, or payment, is sent electronically... shall be deemed to be the date of delivery

dimensions.assessment: No direct federal spending or revenue changes are stated or implied beyond potential administrative adjustments.
Amends a specific section of the Internal Revenue Code regarding electronic transmission dates and IRS guidance.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to provide for the application of the mailbox rule to documents and payments electronically submitted

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change applicable to documents and payments sent after December 31, 2025.
dimensions.evidence: The amendments made by this section shall apply to any document or payment sent after December 31, 2025.

missing_information: Quantitative estimates of delayed payment penalties avoided by taxpayers
importance_detail.rationale: The bill extends the mailbox rule to all electronically submitted federal tax documents and payments to the IRS and mandates related regulatory guidance.
